_doc: The single-station test sites of mppp.ibr (Christian, 10 Nov 2026: 'We'll use these three as the test sites ... the single sites should come from a config file'). python -m mppp single-sites [LABEL ...] runs them: the dense step in the block, then mesh / depthmaps --photometry / ods into <out>/<label>/ (rover masked out) and <out>/<label>/with_rover/ (rover shown). Per station: 'site' (a site of mppp/data/sites.json; the block is its Navcam WORK folder) or 'work' (a block folder), 'station' (S003D2046 / 3_2046), 'frames' (the dense step's frames: 'images' [names], 'scale' (0.5: the half-resolution frames), 'sequences' [NCAM...]); optional 'variants' (masked, rover), 'mesh_args' / 'depthmaps_args' / 'ods_args' (extra arguments), 'note'. Top level: 'dense_args' for every station's dense step (and per station the same key).

S003D2046.note: Van Zyl Overlook, sol 52: the six Navcam pairs NCAM00303, NCAM03052 x3, NCAM02052 x2 (Christian, 10 Nov)

S026D0630.note: Rockytop, sol 461: the 16 half-resolution Navcam frames (NCAM03461, 02461, 13461)

S032D1184.note: Three Forks, sols 686 and 688: the 26 half-resolution Navcam frames (NCAM02686, 03686, 12686, 03688, 13688)
